title: Toma input event
description: One line of takes/<take>/events.jsonl (format 1.0): a compact JSON object, keys in alphabetical order, that ends in "\n". Every event has t and type; the other fields depend on type and are at the same level. A reader skips a line whose type it does not know (a later version can add types without raising the manifest's version) or that lacks a field its type needs. Coordinates are global points, the origin at the top left of the main display, y down. See docs/format/README.md, "events.jsonl".

t.description: When it happened: a HostTime, nanoseconds of the Mac's CLOCK_UPTIME_RAW.

type.description: What happened. This version writes: cursor, mouseDown, mouseUp, displayGeometry, segmentStarted, streamInterrupted, paused, resumed, deviceChanged, marker, droppedSamples, audioClock, windowGeometry, cameraStyle, cursorImage, scroll, keyActivity, keyPress, focus.

x.description: cursor, mouseDown, mouseUp, scroll: the pointer; focus: the left edge.

y.description: cursor, mouseDown, mouseUp, scroll: the pointer; focus: the top edge.

button.description: mouseDown, mouseUp: left, right, or other for any other button.

frame.description: displayGeometry, windowGeometry: a rectangle in global points; audioClock: the number of a sample of the segment's file, from 0.

track.description: The id of a track of the manifest.

index.description: segmentStarted: the number of the segment the track opened.

code.description: streamInterrupted: the NSError's code; keyPress: the key's virtual code, 0 to 65535.

reason.description: paused: willSleep, screenLocked or user; a reader takes one it does not know.

deviceUniqueID.description: deviceChanged: the uniqueID of the device the track records from now.

count.description: droppedSamples: the samples the track lost so far in its current segment.

onScreen.description: windowGeometry: whether macOS has the window on screen.

style.description: cameraStyle: how the camera looks from t.

hash.description: cursorImage: the name of its image, takes/<take>/cursors/<hash>.png.

hotspot.description: cursorImage: where the pointer is in the image, fractions of its width and height from the top left.

size.description: cursorImage: the cursor's size in points.

kind.description: cursorImage: the system cursor it looks like (arrow, iBeam, pointingHand, openHand, closedHand, crosshair, resizeLeftRight, resizeUpDown, notAllowed; another one is read as none); focus: element or caret.

dx.description: scroll: the horizontal points scrolled in 1/30 s.

dy.description: scroll: the vertical points scrolled in 1/30 s.

chars.description: keyPress: what the key types with only Shift of its modifiers; missing if it types nothing.

mods.description: keyPress: the modifiers, the low 32 bits of CGEventFlags.

repeat.description: keyPress: whether it is the key's automatic repeat.

key.description: keyPress: what the key types without modifiers; missing where chars is.

cameraStyle.description: How the camera looks: its shape, its size and where it is anchored.

size.description: The camera's side as a fraction of the output's height: 0.17 small, 0.24 medium, 0.33 large.

anchor.description: One of the 8 places at the corners and the middle of the edges; leading is always the left.
